_comment: Manual category overrides applied at the bridge boundary so we never have to edit the upstream-generated ModuleAdd.h. Mostly: assigning real categories to effects that arrive labelled 'Unclassified'. Family rule: an effect named X3 inherits X2's category; an effect named ConsoleY{Buss,Channel,Pre} goes under 'Consoles'. The truly orphan effects (no whatText, no awpdoc, no predecessor) are best-guess and should be reviewed: BitDualPan, CStrip, PearLiteEQ, PunchyDeluxe, PunchyGuitar, WoodenBox, X2Buss, and Longhand. Longhand (added 2026-06-01 upstream sync) has only Input/Output/Dry-Wet and no blog post yet — 'Effects' is a pure placeholder; reclassify once Chris documents it.
